read.en: Corning fell 3.3% on Nov 10 to $112.13, trading $110.12–115.63 on light volume (0.67x the 20-day average). It is above the 5-day ($111.3) and below the 10-day ($118.9), 30-day ($135.9), 100-day ($156.7) and 200-day ($156.4); only the 200-day is rising. MACD has been below its signal since Oct 12, below zero, histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 12 ($116.45), and RSI is 37.
read.zh: 康宁 11月10日下跌 3.3%，收于 $112.13，盘中区间 $110.12–115.63，成交量偏低（20 日均量的 0.67 倍）。股价位于 5 日（$111.3）均线上方，10 日（$118.9）、30 日（$135.9）、100 日（$156.7）和 200 日（$156.4）均线下方；仅 200 日均线在上行。MACD 自 10月12日起位于信号线下方，在零轴下方，柱状图收窄；抛物线 SAR 自 10月12日起看空（$116.45），RSI 为 37。

read.en: The close lost the $114.2–115.4 support (Nov 5 high, Jul 28 and Nov 4 lows), now resistance; the $110 area held (Nov 10 low $110.12). Resistance is $114.2–115.6 (Nov 10 high), then $116.5–118.9 (SAR, Nov 9 high, 10-day) and $123.2–123.8. Support is $110–111.3 (5-day, Nov 10 low), then $104.1 and $101.8 (Nov 5 low). A close above $115.6 would target $116.5–119; below $110, $104.
